notes.zh: 优化完整高斯的默认着色、纹理寻址与屏幕外剔除，减少原本低于透明度阈值的外围绘制；编辑标记纹理采用单字节存储。不下采样，保留完整模型。提供默认关闭的投影复用对照开关；新增自动旋转诊断及事件、动画调度延迟统计。
notes.en: Optimize full-resolution direct Gaussian shaders, texture addressing and conservative offscreen/transparent-support rejection; compact edit flags. No source sampling. Optional projection reuse is off by default. Add automatic orbit diagnostics and event/animation scheduling timings.
